---

name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new feature
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
-------------

## Problem or motivation

Describe the problem, limitation, or user need this feature would address.

## Proposed solution

Explain the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Expected benefits

Describe how this feature would help users, contributors, or the project.

## Proposed implementation

If applicable, suggest how the feature could work or be implemented. Technical suggestions are welcome but not required.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional context

Add examples, mockups, screenshots, references, or related issues if available.
